name: Ta Jiang Co., Ltd.
summary: Ta Jiang Co., Ltd., based in Taiwan, operates extensively in both the textile and construction industries. Its textile division covers a broad range of activities, from the spinning, dyeing, weaving, and finishing of fabrics and their raw materials to the manufacturing, processing, and trading of various garments, including woven and knitted apparel, as well as sweaters. The company also produces, dyes, finishes, and sells chemical fibers, alongside manufacturing specialized machinery and equipment for the textile sector. Notable product offerings include anti-pilling ball blending yarn, microfibers, and Lycra rhythm fabrics. In its construction segment, Ta Jiang undertakes diverse projects. It designs and contracts environmental engineering solutions for public nuisances, such as the treatment of wastewater, waste gas, garbage, water and fertilizer, and sanitary sewers. The company further specializes in general water treatment and solar hot water heating systems. Beyond environmental services, it develops, leases, and sells residential and commercial properties, invests in public infrastructure initiatives, and handles the development, sale, and rental of industrial facilities. Additionally, Ta Jiang exports and sells water spray and related equipment and parts. The company was founded in 1967 and maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
